subject: Post-call: Mapping token economics to environments & support for private VPC pilot
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Anita Shah <anita.shah@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-30T15:02:00Z
Subject: Post-call: Mapping token economics to environments & support for private VPC pilot

Hi Anita — thanks again for a productive conversation earlier. Quick recap and the asks we agreed on so everyone is aligned: 

Summary from call:
- Pilot scope: Private VPC deployment in us-east-1, 3 environments (dev, stage, prod) with an initial cap of 8 GPU instances for prod during the pilot window.
- Workloads: clinical notes summarization + internal search embeddings. Expected 10M inference tokens/day peak, baseline 2M/day.
- Security: SOC2 + customer-managed KMS required; we'll surface audit log options.

Pricing/Unit-econ topics we covered (items you asked us to put in writing):
1) Target unit price: you asked for a target around $850–$1,200 per 1M inference tokens (post-discount) — we'll show where that lands vs. hosting and reserved capacity.
2) Licensing models: three options we proposed during call — (A) token-only hosted add-on (metered) + private control plane fee, (B) reserved capacity flat monthly + modest token overage, (C) capacity + perpetual seat/license for on-prem delivery.
3) Support tiers: Standard (8x5, 24h response), Business (24x7 with 4h P1), Enterprise (designated TAM, 1h P1). You preferred Business or Enterprise for pilot.
4) Environment mapping: dev/stage/prod split and whether dev can be shared across teams (you expressed preference for separate stage and prod).

Requested next steps (action items):
- Ben: send a short cost worksheet mapping the three licensing models to your banded token volumes (attached: Helix_vpc_token_model.xlsx).
- Anita: confirm realistic 3-month token profile (we used 2/5/10M tokens/day for our worksheet — please correct).
- Marissa/Karthik: prepare two pricing slides — one focused on unit price per 1M tokens at the 1M/10M/30M scales, another showing committed capacity vs metered.

Attachments: Helix_vpc_token_model.xlsx (cost model), Redwood private pilot SLA (redwood-private-pilot-sla.pdf) attached.

If you can confirm the 3-month projection by EOD Friday we’ll turn this into a formal pilot proposal with explicit price bands and a recommended configuration.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Anita Shah <anita.shah@helixhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@helixhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-01T09:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call: Mapping token economics to environments & support for private VPC pilot

Thanks Ben — useful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Token profile: Updated projection attached in-line below — for 3 months our internal forecast is closer to 1.5M / 4M / 9M tokens/day (so slightly lower on month 1, similar by month 3). I'll upload a CSV if helpful.
- Environments: Dev can be a small shared cluster (1xA10g), stage dedicated (2xA10g), prod 8xA100p as you modeled.
- Support: We prefer Business tier for the pilot; need 24x7 with 4h P1, and 1-week notice for scheduled maintenance.
- Licensing: We're most interested in option (B) reserved capacity + token overage for predictability, but please include option (A) as backup for flexibility.

Attachment: helix_token_projections.csv (referenced)

Appreciate the fast turnaround — Liam and I will review the attached workbook and aim to confirm by Thursday close of business.

— Anita
Anita Shah
Director, Applied ML | Helix Health
anita.shah@helixhealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-01T10:05:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: Mapping token economics to environments & support for private VPC pilot

Ben / Karthik — forwarding Anita's note. She narrowed the profile to 1.5/4/9M tokens/day and wants Business tier. 

Quick internal notes and pricing approach suggestions:

- Pricing levers to show:
  * Unit cost per 1M tokens (inference-only) at 1M / 10M / 30M scales after each licensing model discount.
  * Effective $/1M including infra amortization for reserved vs metered (assume 60% utilisation for reserved baseline).
  * Add-on fees: private control plane (monthly), KMS integration (one-time), audit log retention cost per GB/month.

- For Helix we should present a recommended default: Reserved capacity (option B) sized to cover expected peak with a 15% buffer, token overage at 60% of the listed unit price, and Business support included for pilot (roll into committed price).

- Edge case: If they choose to start metered and convert to reserved after month 2, include a conversion credit that applies to the committed monthly fee.

Karthik — can you prepare two quick slides: 1) unit pricing table comparing options A/B/C at their three scale points, 2) recommended configuration + monthly TCO (showing tack-on fees). I can draft the SLA bullets.

Marissa
VP Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Anita Shah <anita.shah@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T19:23:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call: Mapping token economics to environments & support for private VPC pilot

Great — thanks for the numbers, Anita. Actioning next steps below and timeline: 

What we'll send by EOD Monday:
- A 1-page pilot commercial (3-month term) showing:
  * Two priced options: Reserved-capacity pilot (recommended) vs Metered pilot.
  * Unit $/1M tokens at 1M / 10M / 30M bands (post-discount) and an example monthly invoice for the month-3 profile (9M tokens/day).
  * Included Business support and Pilot SLA summary (redwood-private-pilot-sla.pdf).
- A short spreadsheet with line items (Helix_vpc_token_model.xlsx) reflecting their 1.5/4/9M/day profile and the conversion credit.

Questions for you (Anita) — please reply inline: 
1) Is a 3-month pilot term OK, or do you prefer a 6-month evaluation?
2) Are there any procurement constraints (PO process, minimum invoice terms) we should be aware of before we send the pilot contract?

If we don't hear otherwise we'll assume 3 months and that payment will be via PO on net-30. Looking forward to finalizing — we'll aim to keep the target effective $/1M token near the band you mentioned.

Cheers,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
